LESSON: CALMING THE STORM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Miracles of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: Calming the Storm

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Calming the Storm
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does the miracle of calming the storm relate to challenges facing people today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the miracle of calming the storm
2. identify the challenges they face in daily life
3. apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the miracle of calming the storm

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the miracle of calming the storm.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe the miracle of calming the storm” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths

• Your turn: show "apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the miracle of calming the storm
• Model 2: identify the challenges they face in daily life
• Model 3: apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the miracle of calming the storm
2. Practise: identify the challenges they face in daily life
3. Practise: apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Calming the Storm.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the miracle of calming the storm relate to challenges facing people today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the miracle of calming the storm
• identify the challenges they face in daily life
• apply lessons learnt to overcome the challenges they face as youths

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
